title: helleborine pallida
intro: Helleborine pallida, commonly known as the pale helleborine, is a species of orchid native to Europe and Asia. It is a perennial orchid that thrives in shaded woodlands and is characterized by its delicate white flowers. The pale helleborine has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, thanks to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of helleborine pallida include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
